grillspett-premium-rostfritt-stal.title: Premium BBQ Skewers 6 Pack – Stainless Steel with Wooden Handles
grillspett-premium-rostfritt-stal.descriptionHtml:
Barbecue like a pro with our premium stainless steel BBQ skewers.
The set includes 6 sturdy skewers with handsome wooden handles that give you a solid grip and that classic barbecue feel. Perfect for meat, chicken, fish, veggies – or why not a luxurious shish kebab.

The stainless steel skewers are hard-wearing, easy to clean and can be used again and again – a sustainable alternative to single-use wooden skewers.

Features:

  • 6-pack of premium BBQ skewers

  • Made from stainless steel for long-lasting durability

  • Comfortable wooden handles for a secure grip

  • Perfect for meat, chicken, veggies & fish

  • Reusable & easy to clean

Why choose stainless steel BBQ skewers?

Unlike single-use wooden skewers they won't burn, they're more stable and they can be used year after year. That makes barbecuing smoother, smarter and more sustainable.

Perfect for everyday cooks on the barbie and festive BBQ nights with family and friends!

Crafted from thick, hard-wearing leather that only gets better looking with time. The apron isn't just protection against spills and splatters – it's an investment that will stay with you for many years to come. Over time, every apron develops a unique patina that makes it entirely your own.

The adjustable neck strap and sturdy ties keep it comfortable whatever your build, and the timeless design means you can wear it just as easily at the BBQ as in the kitchen – or when you're taking your barbecuing to the next level.

Features:

  • Made from genuine premium leather

  • Hard-wearing and long-lived – gets better looking with age

  • Adjustable neck strap for the perfect fit

  • Protects against heat, grease splatter and spills

  • Suits the BBQ, kitchen, bar & outdoor cooking

An apron for the true food lover – style, durability and quality in one. Perfect as an investment for yourself or as a seriously luxurious gift.

skarbrada-i-andtra-premium-valnotstra-36.title: End Grain Chopping Board – Premium Walnut, 36 x 24 x 2.5 cm
skarbrada-i-andtra-premium-valnotstra-36.descriptionHtml:
Elevate your cooking with an exclusive chopping board in solid walnut. This end grain chopping board isn't just an elegant addition to your kitchen – it's also built to last and to be gentle on your knives.

Thanks to the unique structure of end grain timber, the board ”self-heals” small cut marks, so it keeps its fine surface even with daily use. At the same time, the material protects your knife's edge, keeping your knives sharper for longer.

Every board is carefully handcrafted with high precision, making it both a practical tool and a stylish detail in the kitchen. It's robust enough for meat and firmer produce, but works just as well for bread, vegetables and fruit.

Features:

  • Premium end grain walnut

  • Dimensions: 36 x 24 x 2.5 cm

  • Self-healing surface that reduces cut marks

  • Gentle on knives – keeps the edge sharper for longer

  • Robust and durable – built for daily use

  • Elegant design suited to both food prep and serving

A chopping board for those who value quality, function and design in one product. Perfect as a gift or as an investment in your own kitchen.
